big_case.notes: SG petition on the scope of the INA terrorism material-support bar (whether coerced, de minimis support such as cooking for captors is 'material'), from a published 2-1 Fourth Circuit decision rejecting the BIA's Matter of A-C-M- reading and en banc denied. Recurring across many asylum/withholding cases with a post-Loper Bright agency-deference angle; the Court granted plenary review. Significant within immigration law, not a headline constitutional case.
